layers.authority: Instituto Chico Mendes de Conservação da Biodiversidade (ICMBio)
layers.process: Chapada dos Veadeiros National Park, night trails: hiring a guide is mandatory, with up to six people per guide. Camping and tents are not allowed during the night period. Tickets must be bought in advance, at the box office (open until 4 pm) or the day before.

sources.supports: mandatory guide on night trails, six per guide, camping ban (news item dated 31 March 2022, page shows a later update; read directly 2026-11-06)

zone-requirements.note: Night trails only, from a 2022 ICMBio news item whose page shows a 2026 update date; the current schedule and ticket prices were not confirmed. Daytime guide rules and fees were not found on an ICMBio page.
